title: In This Aquarium the Night Shift WAVES at the Big Tank
description:
Flashing lights and fast cuts from 0:02 to 2:13.

A short scary story about the night shift at an aquarium. It's made up.

Our shift is three people in one long dark hall. One whole side is glass. Rosa waves goodbye to the big tank like she means it.

The aquarium, the characters and the sound are all built with code and Blender.
pin: who uses that hatch in the ceiling?
